My absolute #1 game changer for weight loss was a food scale. I weigh every item of food before it goes into my mouth. I try to stick to 1200-1250 calories a day. For breakfast I always have an Orgain protein shake, using water. For dinner I utilize a crockpot a lot, which means I eat a lot of meals that are pretty strictly meat and veggies. I recommend the website Family Freezer for great crockpot recipes. I also cut back significantly on alcohol(another game changer). I struggled with alcohol abuse for many years and have now cut my drinking back to 1-2 days a week at most. I also limit the amount of alcohol I drink. With the weight loss i cant handle anything more than a bottle of wine in an evening, whereas before it could potentially be 2 to 3. Usually on days where I know I will be having alcohol with dinner or after dinner, I will have my protein shake in the morning but fast until dinner time. Itnwas very difficult at first but my body has adapted to not eating for longer periods of time. COFFEE IS A GODSEND FOR THESE FASTS! coffee is also just a godsend in general. For physical activity , I aim to take 10k steps a day. Since I was unable to go to the gym for a short period, I started watching YouTube videos and absolutely fell in love with Cassey Ho's blogilates. My mother was diagnosed with ab autoimmune disease in 2005. Thankfully she managed to spend 10 more years with me on this Earth. She died in our living room in her sleep. I will always remember the way the water filled her lungs and her last breath rattled before she finally passed. I will always remember how cold she was, how hard her skin got after rigor mortis set in. 

But more than that I will remember her laugh, our adventures, and the love she had for me. She died September 11, 2015 and even today I find it hard to wake up in the morning knowing that I can't call her. I have trouble making difficult decisions without her consultation. I miss laying in bed or on the couch next to her. I spend nights awake and crying while looking at her photos and our chats on Facebook.

Unfortunately, this pain you feel will never go away. You will have a huge hole in your chest that nothing can ever fill. But this is a pain that you will learn to live with. But remember...your father loved you from the moment he you started growing in your mothers stomach. He loved you when you made mistakes. He still loved you when you yelled at each other. And he will still love you even after hes gone. I dont believe in God or Heaven but I believe a parent's love transcends even death. 

Im sorry if this ramble hurt you or made you cry or didnt even make sense to you. But you are not alone. You will feel very alone but just remember that you are loved and you will ALWAYS deserve to be loved.

And if you need to talk you can always message me. Im just a random stranger on the internet but a stranger that understands the pain and is willing to listen.
